description: isometric pixel art building for a fantasy village builder game, bright vivid saturated colours, crisp dark outlines, a single isolated object on a plain background, part of a stone stronghold at the edge of a forest, standing directly on bare ground with no ground tile, base or platform under it, the guild's pagan shrine: a small old Slavic temple (gontyna) built all of dark carved wood on a low footing of grey hewn stone, a steep wooden shingle roof with two crossed carved horse heads on the gable, carved wooden posts with Slavic folk patterns and sun signs, the front open, inside it a tall carved wooden idol post with a bearded face under a round cap, a small fire burning in a stone bowl and offerings of bread, red apples and wildflowers before it, no people
